title: The winter and summer blooms of the Arabian Sea
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll, nitrate and oxygen for 2011-2020 in the western and northern Arabian Sea (47-70 E, 4-26 N), characterize the two seasonal chlorophyll blooms, the winter bloom in the north and the summer bloom in the west: where and when each occurs, how large it is, how it varies from year to year, and what controls it. Temperature, mixing and winds are not supplied; state what that prevents you from concluding.
